english.notes:
IMPORTANT NOTE
The Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997 are repealed from 22nd April 2016. However, these regulations may still be used for offences relating to Pelican crossings; this is providing the Pelican crossings were established prior to 22nd October 2016 (6 months from the date of repeal), by virtue of regulation 14(5) of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

No endorsement or disqualification if offence committed in respect of a non-motor vehicle.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
